summary: Created Trellis deep task for Yudi SaaS upstream governance, covering repository roles, upstream-first bug fixes, thin customer forks, release/backport policy, and verification evidence.

Added root navigation and contribution rules stating that novusai-saas-yudi is the canonical multi-tenant SaaS upstream; customer repositories stay as thin forks or overlays; common bugs and shared SaaS features are fixed upstream first.
Added upstream-first bugfix flow, RED/GREEN regression expectations, downstream sync discipline, thin fork policy, allowed overlays, and disallowed long-lived downstream core patches.
Added customer sync runbook, release/backport policy, branch and tag semantics, merge versus cherry-pick guidance, .yudi-base evidence, and production acceptance linkage.
Added a thin Trellis upstream/downstream governance entrypoint that links to the owning runbooks without duplicating their full policy body.
Added PowerShell verifier for customer repository .yudi-base metadata; supports JSON and key-value files and requires upstream, last_synced_at, and base_tag or base_commit.
Whitelisted the new governance docs, Trellis guide entries, Trellis task files, and verifier script so they can be tracked without opening the whole docs or .trellis trees.
Added a GitHub pull request template that makes upstream/downstream ownership, shared-risk areas, RED/GREEN evidence, customer sync metadata, and AI dialogue testing gates visible before merge.
